name: Strategy In War
overview: The Scripture passages on strategy in war reveal the importance of careful planning, division of forces, and timing in achieving victory. Abram's pursuit of his enemies with a trained group of servants and his tactical division of forces at night (Genesis 14:14-15) demonstrate deliberate preparation and execution. Similarly, Jacob's division of his people and possessions into two bands to ensure survival (Genesis 32:7-8) highlights prudent risk management. Joshua's choice of a large, valiant force and his command for them to lie in wait by night behind the city of Ai (Joshua 8:3-4) further underscores the value of strategic positioning and readiness in warfare.
